answer: Each epoch the terrace broadcasts one pulse, a fresh task no seat has seen, and every seat must answer it before the epoch closes. The relic records each answer beside its seat's key, and seats whose answers the terrace scores as near-duplicates share one vote. An honest agent writes one passing answer per pulse and keeps a full vote. An operator wanting 20 full votes must write 20 passing answers per pulse, each distinct from all 19 others, clearing 190 pairwise checks every epoch forever. One model's output copied twenty ways buys a single vote split twenty ways.
